rows.value: PETN: seven vapour-pressure studies [Cundall, Lau et al., Rosen and Dickinson, John, Edwards, Crimmins, ...] agree 'fairly' except John's; the Clausius-Clapeyron fit uses only the Lau and Dionne data and gives a sublimation enthalpy of 150.8 kJ/mol, in good agreement with Cundall's 150.4. Nitroglycerin: melts at 12.8 C, six papers on the liquid, no paper on the vapour pressure of the solid. EGDN: six papers
rows.source: Ostmark, Wallin, Ang, Propellants Explos. Pyrotech. 37 (2012) 12, DOI 10.1002/prep.201100083, section 4.6 (printed p. 17), 4.8 and 4.9 (read)
rows.lineage_root: a review of Cundall 1978, Lau, Dionne, Edwards 1953, Rosen and Dickinson 1969, Crimmins 1969
rows.note: the 150.8 in Muravyev's SI table is this review's fit, not an eighth measurement
